label: Relatedness — ngsRelate methods paragraph
template: Pairwise relatedness was estimated from BEAGLE genotype likelihoods using ngsRelate v{{ngsrelate_version}} [@Hanghoj2019] on n={{n_samples}} samples ({{sample_set}}). We used the Jacquard 9-coefficient EM and KING-robust kinship; the first-degree boundary (KING ≥ 0.177) was further split by IBS0 ≤ 0.008 into parent–offspring versus full-sibling dyads [@Manichaikul2010]. Computation ran genome-wide on the thinned site panel ({{site_set}}).

label: Pedigree — ngsPedigree methods paragraph
template: Trio relationships and family hubs were reconstructed from the genome-wide relatedness matrix using ngsPedigree v{{ngspedigree_version}}. Family hubs were defined as connected components of first-degree dyads; n={{n_hubs}} hubs were retained for downstream Mendelian QC.

label: Comparative breakpoints — methods paragraph
template: Comparative breakpoints between {{focal_species}} and {{n_comparator_species}} other catfish genomes were called by two independent method families. Sequence-level breakpoints were called from pairwise wfmash alignments [@Guarracino2024] ({{wfmash_param_summary}}) via the BP_ATLAS two-pass pipeline (Pass A {{pass_a_segment_kb}} kb, Pass B {{pass_b_segment_kb}} kb), with BP3c reciprocity validating zones from both Cgar and Cmac anchors. Gene-order breakpoints were walked from BUSCO single-copy ortholog tables [@Manni2021] (synteny18 + synteny5) using macrosyntR [@Brandt2023]. Methods were folded by cluster_breakpoints.py (--tol-kb {{tol_kb}}). A breakpoint was reported cross-method-validated only when ≥2 INDEPENDENT method families agreed within tolerance; multiple gene-order sources agreeing constituted *recurrent*, not *cross-method*.

label: LG27 bounded inversion — results paragraph
template: The LG27 region carries a bounded inversion with **both** breakpoints corroborated by independent method families. LG27 @ {{lg27_left_mb}} Mb (span {{lg27_left_span_kb}} kb) and LG27 @ {{lg27_right_mb}} Mb (span {{lg27_right_span_kb}} kb) were each detected jointly by BUSCO gene-order ({{lg27_gene_order_sources}}) and wfmash sequence alignment, and both zones appeared in the BP3c BOTH-anchor reciprocity table (validated from both Cgar and Cmac frames). A third cross-method-validated breakpoint was recovered on LG23 @ {{lg23_mb}} Mb (span {{lg23_span_kb}} kb).

label: LG28 recurrent fusion — results paragraph
template: LG28 @ {{lg28_mb}} Mb showed a recurrent rearrangement supported by three gene-order sources (synteny18, synteny5, and genejson) but was *not* corroborated by wfmash sequence alignment at p90. We therefore report LG28 as a Tier-2 recurrent single-method-family event rather than a cross-method-validated breakpoint, consistent with a karyotype-level fission/fusion whose breakpoint geometry is below the wfmash sensitivity floor in the Clariidae divergence tier.

label: LG01 × LG28 pair-relation — methods paragraph
template: We tested joint inheritance of the {{candidate_a}} and {{candidate_b}} candidate inversions by cross-classifying samples by karyotype at each locus into a 3×3 joint table (homA / het / homB on each axis). Observed cell counts were compared against the product of marginals under independence; a χ² statistic and per-cell residual table were emitted by the `inversion_pair_incompatibility` adapter (v{{adapter_version}}).

label: Path B — popstats groupwise methods paragraph
template: Within candidate {{candidate_id}}, samples were partitioned into homA / het / homB groups by their inversion_karyotypes call. Window-wise per-arrangement diversity (θπ [@Tajima1989], Hp, F_IS) and pairwise group divergence (Hudson's F_ST [@Hudson1992], dXY, dA) were computed with `region_popstats` (v{{popstats_version}}) over {{window_bp}} bp windows. Karyotype assignments below {{min_karyotype_confidence}} posterior were dropped before partition.

label: Path A — Mendelian QC methods paragraph
template: Per-trio Mendelian-error rate inside candidate {{candidate_id}} was computed with the `mendelian` module (v{{mendelian_version}}) on the parent-offspring dyads recovered by ngsRelate. Trios were assembled from the family-hub graph; only first-degree parent–offspring edges (KING ≥ 0.177, IBS0 ≤ 0.008) [@Manichaikul2010] were retained. Per-trio compatibility was scored per cell of the parental karyotype × offspring karyotype table; contradictions were flagged at the trio × candidate grain.

label: Interchromosomal effects — methods paragraph
template: Interchromosomal effects of focal inversion heterozygosity on crossover rate were tested by stratifying per-(chromosome × dyad) CO/DCO counts by parental karyotype at the focal inversion ({{focal_inversion}}). For each tested off-focal chromosome we computed Welch's t [@Welch1947] (CO rate in het parents vs non-het parents) against a family-aware permutation null (n={{n_permutations}} permutations); local inversions on the tested chromosome were entered as covariates. p-values were corrected by Benjamini–Hochberg [@BenjaminiHochberg1995] ({{bh_q}}) and Bonferroni ({{alpha}}/k).

label: Path A — Mendelian result paragraph
template: Across {{n_informative_families}} informative families, {{compatible_pct}}% of parent-offspring transmissions inside {{candidate_id}} were compatible with the called karyotype state. {{n_contradictions}} contradictory transmissions were flagged (≤ {{max_contradiction_pct}}%, within the per-trio genotype-error rate expected for the cohort). The candidate was therefore classified as a {{tier}} Mendelian-supported inversion.

label: HPP — deleterious burden methods paragraph (chain)
template: Per-offspring damaging-variant burden was scored via the haplotype-projection pipeline (HPP v{{hpp_version}}, `ngspedigree_hpp`). Parental consequence-annotated variants were projected onto offspring haplotype copies using the Stage 3 inheritance map; per (offspring, gene, segment) we classified status across the seven-class enum (reference_like / het_masked / hom_exposed_same_variant / compound_het_trans / compound_het_cis / partially_resolved / unresolved). The damaging set followed KBC §1.8 tier {{kbc_tier}} (Tier 1 / 2 / 3 selected at runtime); per-segment confidence (Gold / Silver / Bronze) propagated to the gene-status row. Triads carry full Mendelian + de-novo flags; dyads carry the parent-homozygous subset only.

label: HPP × KBC — damaging variants inside inversions methods paragraph
template: For damaging variants falling **inside** inversion intervals (candidate {{candidate_id}}), we cross-checked HPP per-offspring haplotype-copy assignment against the KBC karyotype-derived arrangement-background assignment. Concordance was scored per (offspring × variant); discordances were flagged as diagnostic of Stage-3 boundary noise or KBC-edge effects, **not** primary results. The crosscheck was scoped to `inversion_intervals_only` and `damaging_only`; variants outside inversions or below the damaging threshold were excluded from the comparison.

label: HPP — deleterious burden inside LG28 (results paragraph)
template: Within candidate {{candidate_id}}, {{n_offspring}} offspring carried at least one damaging variant (KBC Tier-{{kbc_tier}}) projected onto a Gold-confidence haplotype segment. {{n_hom_exposed}} of these were in `hom_exposed_same_variant` state ({{hom_exposed_pct}}% of carriers), {{n_compound_het}} in `compound_het_trans` ({{compound_het_pct}}%), and {{n_het_masked}} in `het_masked`. Burden was {{burden_direction}} in the inverted arrangement compared to the standard arrangement ({{burden_test_pct}}%, {{burden_test_label}}). {{n_discordant}} offspring × variant pairs were flagged by the HPP × KBC arrangement crosscheck as boundary/edge effects and excluded from the burden tally.

label: πN / πS burden proxy methods paragraph
template: Per-CDS-locus nonsynonymous (πN) and synonymous (πS) nucleotide diversity were computed with coverage correction and bootstrap CIs ({{n_bootstrap}} replicates) via the `pi_NS` module. The πN/πS ratio per locus was compared between karyotype groups (homA / het / homB at {{candidate_id}}) as a purifying-selection / deleterious-load proxy. πN/πS was complemented by π@0-fold (purifying) vs π@4-fold (≈ neutral) per locus to disentangle mutation-rate from selection effects.

label: Inversion age — BUSCO 4-fold synonymous methods paragraph
template: Per-candidate inversion age was estimated from BUSCO single-copy ortholog 4-fold degenerate (4D) sites [@Manni2021]. For candidate {{candidate_id}}, we computed dxy at 4D sites between samples carrying alternative arrangements; under a strict-molecular-clock approximation, age = dxy_4D / (2μt) using μ = {{mu_per_site_per_year}} mutations · site⁻¹ · year⁻¹. Confidence intervals were obtained by ortholog-block bootstrap (n = {{n_bootstrap}}). Older inversions exhaust the 4D-site signal; ages above {{age_ceiling_my}} My are reported as right-censored.

label: Polarity by outgroup synteny vote — methods paragraph
template: Inversion polarity (reference- vs derived-allele direction) was assigned by an outgroup synteny vote: across the {{n_comparator_species}} catfish comparators (from cross_species_atlas synteny18 + synteny5 tables [@Brandt2023] [@Manni2021]), we counted how many outgroups carry the same arrangement as each candidate side. The arrangement matching the outgroup majority is declared ancestral; the rejected side is derived. Ties (≤{{tie_margin}} outgroups difference) are reported as `polarity = unknown` rather than forced.

label: D / fdM introgression test — methods paragraph
template: Introgression around candidate inversions was tested with Patterson's D-statistic [@Patterson2012] and Malinsky's f_dM [@Malinsky2015] using the (P1, P2, P3, O) quartet ({{quartet}}). Per-window D and f_dM were computed in {{window_bp}} bp windows with block-jackknife confidence intervals. A positive D (excess ABBA over BABA) flags introgression from P3 into P2; the f_dM sign convention is preserved. p-values were corrected by Benjamini–Hochberg [@BenjaminiHochberg1995].

label: Selection scans (iHS + XP-EHH) methods paragraph
template: Positive-selection signatures inside inversion arrangements were screened with iHS (Voight 2006 framing) [@Voight2006] and XP-EHH [@Sabeti2007]. Both statistics were computed in the diploid-IBS approximation from unphased BEAGLE genotype likelihoods (allele 0 assumed ancestral via the outgroup vote, see methods.evolution_polarize_synteny). iHS used freq-binned z-score normalization; XP-EHH used the {{test_cohort}} vs {{ref_cohort}} contrast. Windows above |z| ≥ {{z_threshold}} were flagged.

label: Founder-background demography via MSMC — methods paragraph
template: Per-arrangement effective population size trajectories Ne(t) were estimated with MSMC2 [@Schiffels2014]. Samples were partitioned by their arrangement at {{candidate_id}} and an additional founder-background grouping inferred from long-range haplotype regimes; per group, n = {{n_msmc_haplotypes}} unrelated representatives were selected (kinship θ < {{theta_max_pair}}, ROH-purged). The neutral collinear callable mask excluded inversions, long-range regimes, ROH, repeats, and low-mappability regions. Time was scaled by μ = {{mu_per_site_per_year}} mutations · site⁻¹ · year⁻¹ and g = {{generation_time}} years.

label: Genome-wide individual heterozygosity — methods paragraph
template: Per-sample genome-wide heterozygosity H was computed from the folded 1-D site-frequency spectrum produced by realSFS [@Korneliussen2014] with -fold 1: H = sfs_bin1 / (sfs_bin0 + sfs_bin1). One scalar per sample on the {{sample_set}} cohort; reported as the genome_wide_heterozygosity layer.

label: θπ + θW windows — methods paragraph
template: Per-sample windowed nucleotide diversity θπ [@Tajima1989] and Watterson's θW [@Watterson1975] were computed with ANGSD doThetaStat [@Korneliussen2014] from per-sample folded SFS. The atlas pre-bakes four resolution scales (10kb / 5kb / 50kb / 500kb windows with proportional step sizes); a {{window_bp}} bp × {{step_bp}} bp scale was used for the headline figures.

label: Runs of homozygosity (ROH) per sample — methods paragraph
template: Per-sample runs of homozygosity were extracted from the {{sample_set}} cohort using the diversity-atlas ROH pipeline. Reported metrics per sample: total ROH length (Mb), number of segments, mean segment length, and the F_ROH inbreeding coefficient (F_ROH = total ROH length / autosomal callable length). Segments below {{min_roh_bp}} bp were discarded.
